item.title: Effective Bash Script Debugging: Tracing, Options, and Tools
item.description:
“Effective Bash Script Debugging: Tracing, Options, and Tools”

When developing Bash scripts, identifying and resolving errors is crucial for smooth operation. This exploration delves into various techniques and tools that significantly enhance your debugging workflow, from fundamental shell options to integrated development environments.

Leveraging Shell Options for Tracing

Bash provides built-in options that offer granular control over script execution tracing. These can be invoked directly or embedded within the script itself.
